title: Restitution Art Lab
author: Paradise Garden Productions and the Restitution Art Lab team

notes.text: A hybrid of theatre, performance, film documentation, text, audio collage and symposium made by participants from Berlin, Yaounde, Luanda and Lisbon. Its examples include Ngonnso and Chibinda Ilunga, while its public self-critique warns that dialogue and art events can become delaying tactics instead of direct restitution. The collective authorship belongs to the credited team and individual contributors on the project page; the abbreviated source author is not an attribution of every segment to the production company. No MoSA object relationship is established, and no project media is republished.
